verdict.rationale: TWC's evidence describes only browser-based online services (UTR, UTS) and a desktop QuickFile tool for uploading formatted wage files. Neither is a documented API, let alone one with UI parity. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and the applications host reset keyless agent connections, so there is no evidence of programmatic access matching the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
